title: Nick Cannon Tells Wild Joke About 'Impregnating' Ex-Raw Women's Champion Bianca Belair [Watch]
htmlContent:
Nick Cannon, the father-of-12 and host of the comedy rap battle show, Wild 'N Out, faced severe backlash from fans after he made a controversial joke about WWE star Bianca Belair during an episode. The incident occurred as he performed a spoof of the Fresh Prince of Bel-Air theme song, with Bianca and her husband Montez Ford present as guests on the show. In his rap, Cannon made the inappropriate remark, stating that he wanted to impregnate Bianca Belair, which shocked viewers and ignited a storm of criticism.

While Bianca and Montez appeared to laugh off the comment, fans took to social media expressing their outrage. Many labeled Cannon as "pure garbage" and condemned his statement as a threat. They expressed disbelief and questioned the motivation behind such a distasteful remark. However, some viewers came to Cannon's defense, pointing out that the nature of the show is centered around insulting and roasting opponents during rap battles.

This incident follows a similar controversy where Cannon joked about wanting Taylor Swift to be the mother of his 13th child. The cumulative effect of these incidents has further fueled criticism towards Cannon, with accusations of misogyny and objectification of women. The host, who has children with multiple partners, has faced scrutiny for his public comments, which many believe reduce women to mere child-bearing objects.

Amid the backlash, it remains to be seen how Cannon will respond to the public outcry and whether he will address the concerns raised regarding his jokes. The incidents have reignited conversations about respect, boundaries, and the responsibility of public figures in their words and actions.
